topic: Salary account? One big bank cut free other-bank ATM uses from 10 to 5 a month; each extra cash withdrawal costs ₹23 + GST
experiment: EXPLOIT news-list on a fee that hits salaried viewers monthly; tests a small, certain rupee cost (₹23) against the big-number hooks.
caption:
Does your salary account still give you 10 free ATM uses? At one big bank, it's now 5.

From 1 October, one large public-sector bank cut free monthly uses at other banks' ATMs for salary accounts from 10 to 5.
After that, each cash withdrawal costs ₹23 + GST and each balance check ₹11 + GST. Balance checks count towards the 5.
Rules differ by bank and account, so check yours.
